description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing CachedListItemEntity objects within a Room database, including methods for querying, deleting, and inserting cached list items based on scope parameters.

classes.name: CachedListItemDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for CachedListItemEntity objects in the Room database.

methods.name: listForScope
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CachedListItemEntity objects filtered by userId, role, and kind, ordered by sortOrder.

methods.name: deleteForScope
methods.description: Deletes cached list items matching the specified userId, role, and kind.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of CachedListItemEntity objects into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

calls: QUERY (SELECT * FROM cached_list_items WHERE userId = :userId AND role = :role AND kind = :kind ORDER BY sortOrder ASC)
QUERY (DELETE FROM cached_list_items WHERE userId = :userId AND role = :role AND kind = :kind)
